creator: admin
title: Things to try
text:
!! Open it offline

Visit once with a network, then turn your connection off and reload. The wiki opens from your device, with every tiddler it has loaded. The cloud icon's menu, at the top of the sidebar, says you're offline.

!! Install it

On a phone, use "Add to Home Screen". On a desktop, Chrome shows an install button in the address bar. The installed app opens offline too.

!! Search everything

The sidebar's search covers every tiddler, since the wiki loads them all in the background after the first one you open.

!! Find the way in

The cloud icon's menu has ''Log in to edit''. It opens the admin site in a new tab. For a visitor that's the login page; for the owner it's the wiki, editable.
